segments.text: Welcome to the sunny paradise where crystal clear turquoise waves meet pink coral sand.
Luna and Milo explore the magical rainbow meadow filled with giant pastel blossoms.
Discover wonder, a world of pure color and joy.
Rainbow hot air balloons rise high above candy colored hills in the afternoon sun.
The golden sunset fiesta begins with floating paper lanterns and sparkling joy.

scenes.name: Mainframe Breach
scenes.prompt: Cyberpunk skyscraper server room at midnight, Alex Vance plugging neural cable into pulsating quantum core, blue neon reflections on rain drenched floor-to-ceiling glass window, cinematic wide shot 8k.
scenes.negative: blurry, deformed, cartoon, low quality, daytime

scenes.name: Laser Corridor Defense
scenes.prompt: Elena Cross in sleek tactical stealth gear crouching beside biometric security door, crisscrossing red laser security beams illuminating misty hallway, tense cinematic lighting.
scenes.negative: blurry, bad anatomy, daylight, low resolution

scenes.name: Mission Complete Title
scenes.prompt: Solid black background, no texture, typography kinetic text overlay: MISSION COMPLETE, $10,000,000 TRANSFERRED.

scenes.name: Megacity Hover Escape
scenes.prompt: Overhead cinematic drone view of glowing cyberpunk metropolis, flying hover vehicles speeding between towering holographic advertisements, neon rain reflections.

scenes.name: Golden Dawn Departure
scenes.prompt: Alex Vance and Elena Cross inside cockpit of sleek aero-transport speeding towards golden sunrise horizon, city skyline fading behind them, hopeful cinematic lighting.

sceneTextById.S01: I was absolutely certain I was going to prison.
sceneTextById.S02: Elena and I had less than three minutes before the lockdown triggered.
sceneTextById.S03: We walked away with ten million dollars and shut down the servers.
sceneTextById.S04: Completely disappeared into the city skyline without a trace.
sceneTextById.S05: My name doesn't matter anymore. We are free.
